title: Pipeline ADR: GitLab-native vs CDK Pipelines, plus endpoint policies
scenario: Security wants deploys executed inside AWS with a named approver, audit wants one record, developers want results on the merge request, FinOps wants it cheap. Write the ADR that picks between GitLab-native cdk deploy, CDK Pipelines sourced from GitLab and a hybrid, and design the VPC endpoint policies, including the OAuth bearer-token case.
task: Compare three delivery options against the stated constraints
Decide and state what you give up
Draw the release flow with digest promotion, approval and rollback
Sketch endpoint policies, including bearer-token callers
acceptance: Rubric-graded: options, decision, flow, endpoint policies, consequences
Endpoint policies handle the Principal "*" constraint for OAuth calls correctly
